account_security_two_factor_state_valid.name: account_security_two_factor_state_valid
account_security_two_factor_state_valid.value:
(
        ("account_security"."two_factor_enabled" = false AND "account_security"."two_factor_method" = 'off')
        OR
        ("account_security"."two_factor_enabled" = true AND "account_security"."two_factor_method" IN ('authenticator', 'email', 'phone'))
      )

users_contact_method_required.name: users_contact_method_required
users_contact_method_required.value: "email" IS NOT NULL OR "phone_number" IS NOT NULL
